description: Per-character lists of decal Blueprint asset names used to assemble battle-prepare and battle-preload requests. The export is one 11-row DataTable (ImportKeyField=Id), with five FileName_BP slots per row and no decal placement, size, lifetime or gameplay parameters.

ID.simple: Row key, normally the Character row ID referenced by Character::Id_CharacterDecal.
ID.technical: FName key (UPROPERTY BlueprintReadWrite/EditAnywhere; export Properties.ImportKeyField is Id and every master row writes a matching ID). BattleAssets_CharacterDecals_12BC3C0 reads Character::Id_CharacterDecal (FGameDataTableRow_Character +0x70 in the retail layout), returns immediately when it is None, and finds the first matching row across AGameDataTableManager::CharacterDecalDataTables (DTM +0x500) with FindRow(..., false), which suppresses a missing-row warning. No reconstructed consumer reads the embedded Id value; lookup uses the UDataTable row name. The 11 master rows are exactly the 11 non-None Character.Id_CharacterDecal values: ten same-ID links plus CN_071 -> CN_070 (there is no exported Character row named CN_070).

FileName_BP.simple: Ordered list of decal Blueprint asset names (DCL_*_BP) to load for the character.
FileName_BP.technical: TArray<FName> (UPROPERTY BlueprintReadWrite/EditAnywhere; reconstructed retail row +0x10). All 11 exported rows have five slots: 25 non-None names and 30 None slots. BattleAssets_CharacterDecals_12BC3C0 appends every element in array order, including None, to the caller's TArray; it assigns no per-slot meaning. The names become GamePrimaryAssetType_Decal primary-asset names (Config scans /Game/Decals for GameDecalActor_BP_C): GamePrimaryAssetLoader_CreateLoaders skips None names and deduplicates by FName in a TMap, so trailing None slots and duplicates across characters do not create loaders. The shared collector serves GamePhase_BattleBase prepare state 1 (after a variation-row check, including transformation entries) and UGamePhase::PreloadCharacterDecals (CharacterId/Character row only, with transformation slots appended). Other decal systems can resolve the same primary-asset cache by name (GameRenderManager::SpawnDecal builds FPrimaryAssetId("Decal", FileName) and casts the loaded object to an AActor subclass), but no reconstructed caller ties this table's names to a particular spawn. All 25 non-None values also appear as DecalDataTable Filename values; that separate table (DTM +0x800) feeds animation-notify/boot-resident decal selection and is not read by this collector.

notes: Export coverage: the single master CharacterDecalDataTable.json has 11 rows; the 11 datatables_by_character/*/CharacterDecalDataTable.json files are one-row projections of exactly those rows (including CN_070 for CN_071), not additional shards. No numbered or locale-specific CharacterDecal export was found. Every row key equals its exported ID, and the set of keys equals the set of non-None Character.Id_CharacterDecal references.

Array convention: every row has exactly five FileName_BP slots; no code indexes them or gives positions 0-4 distinct roles. None is an empty sentinel that the collector still appends, then GamePrimaryAssetLoader_CreateLoadersForIds rejects it. In the export, 25 of 55 slots are real DCL_*_BP names (22 unique) and 30 are None; all 25 also occur as non-resident Filename rows in DecalDataTable.

Lookup precedence and failure: BattleAssets_FindRow walks CharacterDecalDataTables in order and returns the first matching row; with the shipped single table there is no shard fallback. A null Character or None Id_CharacterDecal skips the lookup, and an unresolved row contributes nothing silently. DTM fills CharacterDecalDataTables in Tick only after every DataTable loader completes.

Both callers feed GamePrimaryAssetType_Decal: battle prepare uses StudioCharacterDecalLoaders_9A0 and waits on it before RegisterLoadedBattleAssets, while battle preload uses StudioCharacterDecalLoaders_450; both maps are later retained in StudioRetainedLoaders_90 or released. Prepare skips an entry whose variation row is missing before calling this collector; preload only requires a resolvable Character row. No caller reads CharacterDecalNames from StudioCharacterDecalLoaders_9A0 or _450 after loading.

Evidence strength: the direct collector at retail 0x12BC3C0 is reconstructed C++ that is behaviour-certified (status state behavioural, not byte-matched); its preload caller at 0x13D5EA0 is an INV MATCH, and the DTM +0x500 member is statically pinned. The row struct has no dedicated retail offset static_assert because layout-checks marks it an ambiguous twin family, so the +0x10 array offset is reconstructed rather than separately pinned. No retail Blueprint bytecode was inspected and no Blueprint-only behavior is claimed.

Defaults: FGameDataTableRow_CharacterDecal's constructor body is empty, so an uninstantiated/default row has Id=None and an empty FileName_BP array; the export supplies explicit values in every row. There are no numeric units, negative sentinels, or index-dependent parameters in this row struct.

usages.detail: Registers the single primary-asset name CharacterDecalDataTable among the DataTable loaders.
Creates the DataTable primary-asset loaders; when all complete, Tick resolves this one asset into CharacterDecalDataTables (DTM +0x500).
Skips a null Character row or Character.Id_CharacterDecal = None before any table lookup.
Finds the first FGameDataTableRow_CharacterDecal row whose key matches Id_CharacterDecal across CharacterDecalDataTables.
Appends the whole FileName_BP array in order, including None entries, to the asset-name output.
Battle prepare state 1 calls the collector for each walk entry (including transformation rows) after a variation-row check.
Feeds CharacterDecalNames into GamePrimaryAssetType_Decal loaders in StudioCharacterDecalLoaders_9A0; state 2 waits on them.
PreloadCharacterDecals calls the same collector for battle slots plus transformation slots.
Creates the Decal loaders in StudioCharacterDecalLoaders_450; IsBattleAssetPreload checks their completion.
Shared loader creation drops None primary-asset names and duplicate names before calling AssetManager::LoadPrimaryAsset.
Declares the Decal primary asset type: Blueprint classes under /Game/Decals based on GameDecalActor_BP_C.
Indirect consumer of the shared Decal cache: SpawnDecal resolves a Decal primary asset by FName and casts it to an AActor subclass; this is not a direct reader of CharacterDecal rows.
After preload completes, the character-decal loader map is retained in StudioRetainedLoaders_90 until the phase releases it.
